title: Standards: standardsBinding, R65
prior_work: Meet R65 only (standardsBinding and its op standardsbinding, with its DECLARED_OPS row in bio-plane/src/standards/). BOB's decisions for it: a limit outside 1 to 200 is refused with STANDARD_LIMIT_INVALID; R65's owed line is the requirement as written. The test.todo for R65 in bio-plane/test/m/standards/r65.test.mjs becomes real tests, and when R65 is met you clear its '(not yet met: T53)' mark and remove its '[owed: BOB writes standards' standardsBinding line; no draft holds one]' note yourself (REQ-4). If wiring the op needs a row in bio-plane/src/op-declarations/ or bio-plane/src/op-grades/, do not edit those: say so to your coordinator in your receipt's not-verified list. Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead. No earlier unmerged work touches this module.

status.reason: reopened: Strengthen bio-plane/test/m/standards/r65.test.mjs, from the fresh review of attempt 1 (PR 3). (A) The R37 test has one hidden record with limit 1, so a version that counts hidden records also passes: add a second hidden record (or one hidden and one visible) and assert, for the viewer who may not see them, truncated false and no next. (B) The newest record in the fixture is also the one a sort by kind puts first, so newest first is untested: make the adoption the later of the two and assert the order. The code is correct; change it only if a stronger test shows it is not.
